limitations: Weekly defensive statistics are official box-score production, not charted player-level pressure or coverage impact.
QB hits and sacks are recorded outcomes; they do not capture every pressure or pass-rush win.
Rates per 100 defensive snaps are descriptive workload normalizations, not causal or position-adjusted player grades.
Tackles and passes defended depend on role, opponent play volume and opportunity; comparisons across positions are not direct quality rankings.
Weekly GSIS player IDs are used for the primary snap-to-stat join; unique exact player-name matches are used only where a snap ID is missing.
A resolved snap record can have no weekly box-score row; this is distinguished from an unresolved identity and does not imply inactivity.
Weekly production fields remain missing when no weekly player-stat row exists; they are not converted to zero.
Season per-snap production rates use only snaps from weeks with a corresponding player-stat row; total snaps and stat-record snap coverage are shown separately.
